# opnsense_acmeclient_certificate (Data Source)

ACME certificates (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Certificates**, plugin `os-acme-client`). OPNsense issues and renews them with its cron job; issued certificates appear in **System ▸ Trust ▸ Certificates**.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME certificate.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) Set the ACME CA account to use for this certificate.
- `aliasmode` (String) Configure DNS alias mode to validate the certificate. One of `none`, `automatic`, `domain`, `challenge`.
- `alt_names` (Set of String) Configure additional names that should be part of the certificate, i.e. www.example.com or mail.example.com. Use TAB key to complete typing a FQDN.NOTE:You need to forcefully re-issue the certificate if you change "Alt Names" after the certificate was signed by the ACME CA! Use the "issue" button in the Commands column in this case.
- `auto_renewal` (Boolean) Enable automatic renewal for this certificate to prevent expiration. When disabled, the cron job will ignore this certificate. Note that it is still possible to renew the certificate from the GUI.
- `challengealias` (String) When setting DNS alias mode to "Challenge Alias", enter the domain name that should be used for certificate validation. Please refer to the acme.sh documentation for further information.
- `description` (String) Description for this certificate.
- `domainalias` (String) When setting DNS alias mode to "Domain Alias", enter the domain name that should be used for certificate validation. Please refer to the acme.sh documentation for further information.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this certificate. When disabled, no attemps to issue or renew the certificate will be made.
- `key_length` (String) Specify the domain key length: 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192 or ec-256, ec-384. One of `key_2048`, `key_3072`, `key_4096`, `key_ec256`, `key_ec384`.
- `name` (String) Common Name (CN) and first Alt Name (subjectAltName) for this certificate.
- `ocsp` (Boolean) Generate and add OCSP Must Staple extension to the certificate. When this option is enabled and issueance/renewal requests fail, then this extension is probably not supported by the CA.
- `profile` (String) Optional. Specify the ACME Certificate Profile to use (e.g. "shortlived"). See CA documentation for available profiles.
- `renew_interval` (Number) Specifies the days to renew the cert. The max value is 5000 days.
- `restart_actions` (Set of String) Choose the automations that should be run after certificate creation and renewal. Basically every application requires a quick restart to reload the updated certificate. If you don't configure an automation, the in-memory certificate may expire and cause security warnings and other issues.
- `validation_method` (String) Set the ACME challenge type for this certificate.
